mapper.select: select sum(qty) as virtualDetailQty from virtual_trans_flow_detail where is_deleted = false and virtual_inventory_detail_id = #{virtualInvDetailId} and #{startDate} > bill_date group by virtual_inventory_detail_id

select vidh.date as date, vidh.sku_id as skuId, pd.sku_no as skuNo, pd.name as productName, vidh.warehouse_id as warehouseId, wh."name" as warehouseName, vidh.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, vw.code as virtualWarehouseCode, vw.name as virtualWarehouseName, vidh.update_time as updateTime, vidh.virtual_qty as virtualQty, vidh.virtual_usable_qty as virtualUsableQty, vidh.virtual_frozen_qty as virtualFrozenQty, vidh.avg_inventory_age as avgInventoryAge, vidh.back_avg_inventory_age as backAvgInventoryAge, vidh.is_diff as isDiff, vidh.frozen_qty as billFrozenQty, vidh.frozen_is_diff as frozenIsDiff from virtual_inventory_age vidh left join product_detail pd on vidh.sku_id = pd.id and pd.is_deleted = false left join warehouse wh on vidh.warehouse_id = wh.id and wh.is_deleted = false left join virtual_warehouse vw on vidh.virtual_warehouse_id = vw.id and vw.is_deleted = false where vidh.frozen_is_diff = true and date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'

select vidh.date as date, vidh.sku_id as skuId, pd.sku_no as skuNo, pd.name as productName, vidh.warehouse_id as warehouseId, wh."name" as warehouseName, vidh.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, vw.code as virtualWarehouseCode, vw.name as virtualWarehouseName, vidh.update_time as updateTime, vidh.virtual_qty as virtualQty, vidh.virtual_usable_qty as virtualUsableQty, vidh.virtual_frozen_qty as virtualFrozenQty, vidh.avg_inventory_age as avgInventoryAge, vidh.back_avg_inventory_age as backAvgInventoryAge, vidh.is_diff as isDiff, vidh.frozen_qty as billFrozenQty, vidh.frozen_is_diff as frozenIsDiff from virtual_inventory_age vidh left join product_detail pd on vidh.sku_id = pd.id and pd.is_deleted = false left join warehouse wh on vidh.warehouse_id = wh.id and wh.is_deleted = false left join virtual_warehouse vw on vidh.virtual_warehouse_id = vw.id and vw.is_deleted = false where vidh.frozen_is_diff = true and date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
